items.title: The gfx crate's `tests/golden.rs` binary died once with SIGSEGV under load (1 run in about 30 that day); a native crash in the software Vulkan stack, not in our code
items.discussion: integrator's `scripts/ci-local.sh gfx` on next 052fe60c, 2026-11-13, with two other suites running (load 17): `running 6 tests` then `signal: 11, SIGSEGV`; twelve reruns of the binary and two more full legs passed
items.body: The crate forbids `unsafe`, so the fault is in Mesa, the Vulkan loader or wgpu. Seen before in another shape: wgpu debug labels crashed the Vulkan loader under multi-device tests, which is why instances are created without DEBUG. The six golden tests run as threads of one process, each with its own device. Options if it recurs: run that binary's tests one device at a time (a shared context behind a lock, or `--test-threads=1` for it in `ci-local.sh`), or move it under nextest so each test is a process. Not done on one occurrence. If CI's gfx job dies this way, rerun it and count.
